DAV Center: Marching Tetrahedra - High Performance Computing ...
Apr 28, 2025Marching tetrahedra is a computer graphics algorithm for extracting a polygonal mesh of an isosurface from a 3-D volume. Where the Marching Cubes algorithm works on cubic cells, the marching tetrahedra algorithm works on tetrahedra cells.
